description: This file contains the implementation of the X509Util class, providing utility functions for handling Android's X.509 certificates, trust management, and certificate verification within the Chromium project.

classes.name: X509Util
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for certificate handling, trust management, and verification in Android within Chromium.

classes.name: TrustStorageListener
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that listens for keystore changes to invalidate certificate caches.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes trust managers and certificate factory if not already initialized.

methods.name: createCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from DER-encoded bytes.

methods.name: addTestRootCertificate
methods.description: Adds a test root certificate to the test keystore.

methods.name: clearTestRootCertificates
methods.description: Clears all test root certificates from the test keystore.

methods.name: verifyServerCertificates
methods.description: Verifies server certificates against trust managers and returns verification result.
